fusions.name: Pack-Backed Swipe
fusions.desc: A swipe that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Lead the Hunt
fusions.desc: Lunges at a target up to 6 tiles away and bites for 26 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full range. On a hit, you and your allies deal 15% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Tended Wounds
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to the ally who needs it most, for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Hound of the Band
fusions.desc: A bonded hound runs with you, striking enemies within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.1 seconds. Anything it bites moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.
